capabilities: open bookmarks from a keyboard-driven modal
open all bookmarks in the current group at once
extras: Requires the Bookmarks core plugin to be enabled and bookmarks to exist beforehand; the copy bookmarks.json feature is marked experimental and may be discontinued; URL bookmarks only work in the desktop app.
intentEvidence: Enable the Bookmarks core plugin (Settings → Core plugins → Bookmarks).
problem: Opening bookmarks in Obsidian requires leaving the keyboard home position to click through the Bookmarks panel.
summary: Keyboard-driven modal launcher that opens Obsidian bookmarks via one-letter keys or keyword search.
